svg.title: Prototype 2 - build drawing
svg.text: Third-angle projection. Box with four mesh chambers, access hatches and one Ø19 mm aluminium exchanger tube.
DETAIL H: HATCH HINGE (2 per hatch)
PE drip tube Ø4 mm + fittings
Prototype 2 lines ≈ €220 + €50 concrete; reuses the PVC sheet and drip tube from prototype 1.
All dimensions in mm. Indicative: derived from the bill of materials, not from a verified build.
